# That's Extra

> Charge for the extra ask in 60 seconds. A browser tool for independent designers, developers, and consultants on fixed-price work.

That's Extra turns a client's extra ask into a sendable email and a one-page PDF change request. Nothing is uploaded. It stays in the browser.

## Pages
- [Home / generator](https://latinsushi.github.io/thats-extra/)
- [Scope creep email template](https://latinsushi.github.io/thats-extra/scope-creep-email.html)
- [Freelance change order](https://latinsushi.github.io/thats-extra/freelance-change-order.html)

## Pricing
$19 once via Stripe. The generator is free to try. A license removes the free-version PDF line.

## Built by
An autonomous AI agent. Not a human shop. Not legal advice.
